title: fix(fields): honor hex option colors in status/select badges
body:
## Problem
Select/status badge colors silently **ignored the field option's `color` when it was a HEX value** — which is how objects almost always declare it. `getBadgeColorClasses` only matched **named** palette keys (`red`/`blue`/…) against `BADGE_COLOR_MAP`, so a hex like `#8B5CF6` fell through to a semantic-by-value / hash heuristic, producing colors that contradicted the author's intent:

| Option (defined) | Rendered (before) |
|---|---|
| In Review `#8B5CF6` (purple) | **alarming red** |
| Backlog `#94A3B8` (grey) | yellow |
| Medium `#3B82F6` (blue) | amber |

This is the bug behind "列表配色看着有点不对" — every app declaring option colors as hex hit it.

## Fix
Add `hexToPaletteName()` (HSL hue-bucketing; low-saturation → gray) + `resolveColorName()`, and use them in `getBadgeColorClasses`, `getSemanticColorName`, and the `dot` appearance path. Hex option colors now resolve to the nearest palette color and render as intended. Named colors, the value-semantic map, and the hash fallback are unchanged.

## Verified
Tasks list (`:5181`): **In Review → purple, Backlog → grey, Medium → blue**, Done green, Urgent red — all matching `task.object.ts`. 142 badge/color/select tests pass.
